aPlusContent.rawText:
From the Publisher
Stylish Classic Car and Truck Images 
Color your way through some of some of the most memorable cars in automotive history! This amazing vintage cars and trucks coloring book features 50 incredible images of the most stylish classic cars and trucks in the world. Whether you're a fan of sports cars, classic elegance, vintage pick-ups, or just good old-fashioned styling, you'll find hours of coloring fun. With intricate, unique, full-page designs, each page is an invitation to bring these exotic machines to life with your own unique touch. So grab your favorite coloring tools, sit back, relax, with hours of coloring fun.The book features a wide range of images with varying complexity levels, with a huge host of vehicles including: 
Legendary Automobiless
Vintage Pickup Trucks
Classic Sports Cars
50 Specially-Designed, Full-Page Coloring Pages 
Single-sided printing means there’s no need for you to worry about colors bleeding through and ruining the work on the next page. It also means these images are perfect for cutting out and framing your creations. 
Rev Up Your Creativity 
These stunningly detailed coloring pages are great for car enthusiasts of all ages and ability levels. 
Stress Relief and Relaxation 
This book provides a therapeutic escape from the pressures of daily life. As you color, your mind slows down, and you can let go of stress and worries. The creative process of coloring has been shown to reduce anxiety and promote a sense of well-being. So take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life and allow yourself to unwind with these mesmerizing images. Benefits of coloring include: 
reducing stress and anxiety
improving motor skills and vision
improving sleep
improving focus
Wide Range of Images

With single sided printing, there’s no need for you to worry about colors bleeding through and ruining the work on the next page. It also means these images are perfect for cutting out and framing your creations. 
Hours of Coloring Fun

Give the gift of stress-relief and self-expression with this amazing coloring book. Whether it's for a special occasion or just because, this book is a thoughtful and unique present that give hours of pleasure to someone the car lover in your life.
